snippet.title: Data Rot | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3738180/Data_Rot/

DATA ROT is an ominous, stylized Virtual Reality horror experience!

An insidious entity is taking control of your system, and it's up to you to find and assemble the scattered Data Fragments to eliminate it before it corrupts your entire mainframe.

This game is reminiscent of simple horror games where the player must "collect the pages" while being hunted by a lurking monster.

- 20-45 minute playthrough.
- Simple, easy-to-understand gameplay.
- Dynamic AI Opponent that hunts down the player.
- Roomscale or Seated experience.
- Don't play if VR makes you woozy.
